### I'll Never Fully Understand
Author: Gwen Smith
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/girlfriends/girlfriends-in-god-may-5-2021.html
Passage: Deuteronomy 33:27
Points:
- Human minds naturally seek tidy logic, clear answers, and neatly resolved stories.
- God's eternal nature transcends human comprehension and the boundaries of time.
- Unlike people who tire and lose heart, the everlasting God never grows weary.
- Faith calls believers to trust God's character even when full understanding is impossible.
- In every finite trial, God's everlasting arms provide an unshakable refuge.

### Bible Pathways 03/12/2002
Author: Bible Pathways Ministries
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/biblepathways/bible-pathways-03-or-12-or-2002-1127500.html
Passage: Deuteronomy 33:27
Points:
- The wilderness journey was purposed to develop reliance on God as Israel's true refuge.
- Decades of divine preservation showed that God remains dependable through every difficulty.
- The Lord's everlasting arms are always present and adequate for every circumstance.
- God unfailingly upholds the downcast and cleanses those who turn to Him.
- Faith expressed in loving obedience is met with abundant divine blessing.
